Independent review of Mode4 physical ACK / commit-trace closure

Author freeze: 3cc39cf2bb9278694922109149d73bebf2d0a4576e6a87999489c1143ac19169,
work/native-main-mode4-cold-closure-v13/root-ready-mode4-physical-closure-1.
All 139 payload hashes/lengths were independently checked. The final reader's
strict original identity/context and per-barrier recovery/escrow progression
were reviewed and compiled; the earlier preliminary451 freeze is not promoted.

No actionable reader/metadata production defect was reproduced in the bounded
review. Exact final-source checks: Rust1.90 strict Clippy; 161 copied actual
source/Journal/metadata tests pass, one existing child helper ignored. Four
independent test functions cover eight verifier scenarios. Six pure transforms
apply to committed c5f65fd9d14925b8abec3717318dec943a473587 without Root edits;
input/output hashes are recorded in PURE_CHECKS.json.

Discriminating executed controls:

1. A whole valid Intent/Accepted past-frame swap repairs every sequence and CRC,
   preserving the original current full-KV/path/sequence pin and final Ack.
   The original independent trace refuses; a separately rebound trace still
   cannot validate the malformed barrier graph. Neither attempt changes disk
   bytes or native index state. The independent old-Journal prerequisite also
   proves that a KV-only pin was never a promise of past record ordering.
2. A real partial native write, checked Before reopen, actual replacement plan
   and supersession mapping, durable barrier and actual retry close the valid
   metadata relation. The historical source await is PostVerified but remains
   unresolved; no source result or financial state is supplied by the fixture.
3. Missing and duplicate supersession barriers, a genuinely published original
   copy whose WAL escrow barrier appears only after supersession, and mutation
   bytes/hash from a genuine alternate update(12) rather than source update(11)
   all refuse without consuming the same held operation or modifying its native
   index/WAL. The valid control shares the real recovery construction.
4. A real foreign copy at the SAME configured escrow root has identical complete
   KV, logical sequence and generation, but its distinct actual original store
   identity cannot replace the correct copy. Both source/native states and WAL
   bytes remain unchanged on rejection.

Default/order/ownership scope inspected:

- The old scanner signature remains a noop-visitor wrapper over the same CRC,
  full current-suffix, sequence and complete-KV checks. New trace capture is an
  explicit read under the same lock; the trace's raw frame chain is independent
  of the KV receipt. Bounds are explicit. No repair or writer release is added.
- The old HISTORY reader still invokes inline=false and refuses Mode4 origin.
  The new reader/trace expectation is a separate type/profile; it cannot be
  converted into an old cold executor or hot Session by this package.
- Full recorded barriers and current recovery/escrow progression are required.
  Actual original/copied identity and actual historical views are checked;
  native Before/Intermediate supersession requires exact retained mutations,
  configuration and original read context. Final Post is verify-only.
- Source marking occurs after the complete metadata closure succeeds. Resolve
  is separate. No financial owner, live append plan, retry permit, expected
  financial result importer or stale legacy head is exposed by this reader.
- Administrative metadata observations/archive in the standalone fixtures are
  explicitly opaque. These tests are not full Main/Logic execution or financial
  replay validation. Helper copies of the private Core tests and the native
  capture wrapper were NOT compiled as standalone financial Core code; the
  exact direct/uncompiled source distinction is in FINAL_BINDING.json.

The preliminary observer failure is preserved: one independent Windows test
attempted fs::read while its readonly WAL lock was live. Only the final observer
read was moved after drop(reader), after all semantic assertions. No production
or expected source/native value was changed. Frozen451 retains the preliminary
input, original failed test/log and exact earlier evidence.

Parent's actual private-Core gate separately identified an initial Mode4 source
observation/scope mismatch and is correcting that writer-origin encoder in Root.
That Root delta is outside author3cc and outside these metadata checks. This
review neither claims the three private-Core tests passed nor validates the
new writer-origin correction. No Root edits or whole-Core Cargo were performed.

Trace/barrier order is conditional integrity of retained observed bytes. It is
not proof of historical hardware fsync, power-loss survival, chain consensus,
authenticated actors, unspentness or economic authorization. Supplied hashes
and recaptured trace roots do not create independent authority. Full raw-action
and financial/source reexecution, retained callers, e0/current cold admission,
and ordinary hot-owner release remain separate closed boundaries.

src/source_main_mode4_cold_history_tests.rs. It appends only a nested module.
